For him water is matter that is always about to become another. Hybrids and the out-of-place provoke estrangement, as the mythical monsters of the Middle Ages or Marcel Duchamp’s ready-mades provoked. They cause tumult, un-repair, de-stabilize and lead to rearrangements in our perception. Synthesis work of the exhibition Experiência Tumulto III, Jonas carries the artist’s trajectory, who has been practising displacements since Deitado Eternamente of 1986. It is a taking of things out of place and reordering, but not without first passing through the entrails of the anthropophagic tumult, which may instigate territories of existence and alter the hegemonic modes of subjectivation. In the witches’ cauldron of contemporary art, potions are stirred that mix procedures brought from art history. In Jonas, besides evoking the mythical/biblical Jonas, swallowed by the whale and the medieval practices of founding, the artist refers us to Dadaism and to Minimalism, for he practises displacements and repetitions.
